findings.finding: response.read(cap+1) is one blocking body read. timeout=20 is inactivity timeout, not an absolute request deadline. A continuously drip-fed body can exceed the resolver deadline before associate checks time again.
findings.required: Read bounded chunks with absolute deadline checks and timeouts capped to remaining budget; inert drip/read controls must show timely refusal before another read.

findings.finding: max_length limits decoded bytes but decoder has no memlimit. XZ dictionary memory can be allocated before output cap is evaluated.
findings.required: Set explicit memory limit on decompressor and test rejection of valid XZ requiring more memory than allowed. Keep decoded cap and no concatenated/trailing streams.

findings.finding: Release identity is checked only immediately after gpgv. Inert controlled final-fetch mutation of an earlier InRelease still returns complete association. Existing signed snapshot hash remains valid provenance, but final on-disk identity stability is not verified.
findings.required: Retain verified release identities, compare against earlier authenticated release receipts where available, recheck all exact release bytes/regular-file identity before returning complete; add mutation control.

positiveFindings: Exact name/version/architecture match; missing tuple remains explicit; all six configured main/universe origins retained and conflicting archive/source tuples refuse.
Duplicate control fields reject case-insensitively through existing paragraphs parser; not silently collapsed.
Original INSTALLED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_REVIEW is always re-raised; helper and report remain ready false; no installation path added.
Output linkage failures use fixed reason and allowlisted type; no raw error/env/private path fallback found.
Official suite/host/component URL generation and redirect refusal preserved. Gpgv rechecks signed bytes; APT update owns freshness, not gpgv itself.
limits: No network, APT, gpgv, media, CI or installation executed.
Workflow helper hash binding and current successor authority are explicitly deferred; this proposal alone has no execution authorization.
All-origin means six configured main/universe Noble indexes, not every possible Ubuntu repository.
Source-only review; no public distribution or baseline-upgrade approval.
